notes.title: Idle Roboto Summer Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I hope you are enjoying summer,

I made Idle Roboto slightly more beautiful (I hope!) by reworking several in-game colours and visual effects. I also made the Speed button available right at the beginning of the game, since the penalty won't allow a faster progression than intended anyway.

Have fun !

notes.title: Idle Roboto Hotfix
notes.content:
. Fixed an exploit that was present in the Roboto, Über, Cyber, Gnomon and Shiny challenges, but not in the main game.
. Added a little bit more scrap metal in the game (you are collecting a lot of it!)
